annotations.title: Get a link for the person to view a private file

description: Get a link for the person to view a private file. Needs any of `profile:read`, `content:read`, `inbox:read`, `bookings:read`. Answers a link for the person to open on DJfindr, signed in as themselves; the act happens only there. Give them the url as it is and do not open it or pass it to anyone. Asking again replaces the link given before. get_link says whether it was used.
name: get_file_view_link
title: Get a link for the person to view a private file
